QuestGenerationPage.metaTitle: How are my quests generated? | Questia
QuestGenerationPage.metaDescription: See the full journey: profile, history, today’s context, engine constraints (family, intensity, duration), open-ended AI generation, and safety checks — explained in plain language.
QuestGenerationPage.title: How are your quests generated?
QuestGenerationPage.lead: Every morning, a mission shaped for you: this flow walks from your onboarding answers to the quest you see in the app — with a spark of creativity and guardrails that keep you safe.
QuestGenerationPage.diagramAria: Steps in the quest generation journey
QuestGenerationPage.stepsLoadError: We couldn't load the journey steps. Refresh the page or switch language and back.
QuestGenerationPage.noteBody: Nothing is pure randomness: the engine blends your profile, your history, and the day ahead, then sets today’s trajectory (quest family, intensity, duration). AI writes the words from there; Questia enforces safety, clarity, and respect for your pace.
QuestGenerationPage.privacyNote: You won’t see clinical labels: copy talks about tendencies and rhythm, not diagnosis. Data is used to personalize the experience, as described in our privacy policy.

stepsList.title: Your declared profile
stepsList.body: During onboarding you share how you like to play in real life — explorer vs homebody, cautious vs bold — plus a light personality footprint that steers recommendations without showing clinical jargon in the app.

stepsList.title: Your quest history
stepsList.body: Each completed, accepted, or declined quest leaves a gentle trace. Recent choices feed the engine’s memory — not to judge you, but to understand how you actually move through the world.

stepsList.title: Observed tendencies
stepsList.body: The system infers tendencies from the kinds of quests you’ve lived. It’s a soft read on behavior, not a box you’re locked into.

stepsList.title: Identity ↔ actions gap
stepsList.body: We measure how closely what you say about yourself aligns with what recent quests suggest. That signal tunes tone and intensity — always supportive, never guilt-tripping.

stepsList.title: Your journey phase
stepsList.body: Calibration (near comfort), expansion (small stretch), rupture (bigger challenge): the phase targets the kind of nudge that fits where you are right now.

stepsList.title: Today’s context
stepsList.body: Weather, city, and — if you enable location — whether an outdoor outing makes sense today. When it fits the mission, we may suggest a public place on the map.

stepsList.title: Engine constraints (family, intensity, duration)
stepsList.body: The engine still scores quest families (affinity, phase, freshness, preferences), then picks today’s family, a target intensity, and an ideal duration — using weather, place, and history. The taxonomy is inspiration only: a few short examples may appear in the brief, not a template to copy.

stepsList.title: Open-ended AI generation
stepsList.body: A language model invents the title, hook, and mission from those constraints and today’s context. It’s no longer picking from a list of archetypes: the quest is written for you in a warm narrator voice, with safety, clarity, no medical or dangerous advice, and respect for your language.

stepsList.title: Quality checks & stats anchor
stepsList.body: Automatic rules validate the mission: one actionable sentence, no forbidden content, outdoor place consistency when needed, city mention when GPS is on. A taxonomy id is then attached behind the scenes for the engine’s memory — the copy stays fully creative. If validation fails, we retry or fall back to a safe taxonomy entry.

stepsList.title: Your quest for the day, delivered
stepsList.body: One quest is stored per calendar day: reopening the app the same day shows the same mission — no spam regenerations. Tomorrow the journey runs again with fresh context.

faqItems.question: How is a quest different from a to-do list?
faqItems.answer: A to-do list grows. A quest ends. Each morning you get exactly one, tuned to your profile and the challenge level you picked, with a clear ending and nothing queued behind it.

faqItems.question: One account for everything?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Profile, quests, and progress live on the same account, wherever you play from.

faqItems.question: Is it free?
faqItems.answer: You can calibrate your profile and play your first quests for free. If paid options arrive, they will be announced clearly, with no traps.

faqItems.question: How are my quests personalized?
faqItems.answer: From your profile and the settings you agree to. Missions stay realistic for you, and you stay in control: nothing forces you to accept today's quest.

faqItems.question: Does this replace a health professional?
faqItems.answer: No. Questia is a motivation tool, not a medical or psychological device. If you are going through something serious, talk to a health professional.

faqItems.question: Who is it for?
faqItems.answer: Adults who want a bit more movement in their week without beating themselves up. Useful if you like games, quests, and small concrete wins.
